subject: Post-call: PeregrinePay cost profile, pilot scope, next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@peregrinepay.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@peregrinepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap and cost anchors (PeregrinePay)

Alicia / Mike — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side so we have a shared starting point and clear next steps. I dropped the rough TCO workbook and a draft pilot SOW in the attachments.

Key pain points you described:
- Latency spikes during settlement batch windows (~100–140 req/s peak) causing slow UX and higher support load.
- Current per-request token usage is higher than expected (avg ~150–220 tokens) due to verbose system prompts and multi-turn context.
- Tight monthly budget for inference: indicated $15k–$20k/mo target for the initial rollout.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Hold 95th pctl latency under 350ms for the primary payments UI.
2) Reduce per-interaction token burn by ~30% via prompt tightening + prefix caching.
3) Validate an MVP pilot (10k daily interactions) that demonstrates latency and cost improvements within 8 weeks.

Cost / TCO highlights (back-of-envelope):
- Baseline: at your indicated volumes (350k monthly interactions, avg 180 tokens) we estimate hosted inference spend roughly $24k/mo if unoptimized.
- With batching + prefix/KV cache + a small quantized model variant for low-complexity flows, we can push estimated spend into the $12k–$16k/mo band — depending on cache hit rate and peak concurrency.
- Breakeven on Redwood credits/integration time expected in ~3–5 months given expected reduction in token burn and support costs.

Proposed next steps (short list):
1) I’ll send the populated TCO sheet (attached) with three scenarios: conservative / expected / optimistic — you should have it now.
2) We schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with Marissa (SE) on Monday to review caching strategy and live request shapes.
3) We deliver a pilot SOW draft (attached) that scopes 8 weeks, success criteria, and a capped budget for the pilot.

Can you confirm: (a) procurement cadence (who should I loop in at procurement@)? (b) a good slot for the deep-dive (Marissa is available Mon/Tue next week)?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachments: peregrine_tco_sheet.xlsx (workbook), pilot-sow-draft.pdf (SOW draft)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@peregrinepay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and cost anchors (PeregrinePay)

Priyom — thanks for the succinct recap and for sending the files. A few clarifying points from our side:

- Procurement cadence: procurement@peregrinepay.com is the correct inbox; our procurement lead (cc'd on later emails) will want a fixed not-to-exceed number for the pilot.
- Budget: the leadership team will only approve pilots under $20k total for the initial engagement. That ceiling includes any third-party cloud egress and storage we might incur.
- Metrics: our VP product wants to see both latency and a per-interaction cost delta reported weekly.

Questions:
1) How sensitive is your $12k–$16k estimate to cache hit rate? If hit rate drops to 30% during peak, what happens to run-rate?
2) Can the pilot be scoped to a smaller subset (e.g., support chat flows only) to reduce initial token volume and simplify success criteria?

We’re generally interested but need the pilot cost to be predictable. Please loop in procurement and the tech SE so we can get the detailed numbers.

Best,
Alicia
Head of Product, PeregrinePay
alicia@peregrinepay.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@peregrinepay.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@peregrinepay.com>, procurement@peregrinepay.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and cost anchors (PeregrinePay)

Thanks Alicia — good clarifications. Answers inline and next steps below. Looping Marissa (SE) to validate hit-rate sensitivity and Ben (AE) to handle procurement cadence.

Inline: 
1) Sensitivity: with the assumptions you shared, the estimate is driven primarily by token burn and cache hit rate. Using the attached TCO sheet I ran three scenarios:
   - Hit rate 60% (expected with prefix caching + templating): est $13k/mo
   - Hit rate 40% (mixed traffic): est $18k/mo
   - Hit rate 25% (low cache efficacy during peak): est $22k–24k/mo
These are monthly hosted spend estimates (model + infra). We included a column for ops credits and one-time onboarding to show total pilot spend.

2) Pilot scope: yes — scoping to support chat flows only is a good risk-reduction approach and will materially lower token volume. Suggested pilot: 8 weeks, support chat + escalation routing (roughly 30% of your total interactions). Success criteria: 20% reduction in avg tokens per interaction OR <350ms 95pctl latency for the tested flows, and predictable spend under $20k cap.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Marissa: can you review the TCO sheet and confirm the assumptions for batching (max batch delay 25ms), KV cache warmup, and expected prefix hit rate for templated support responses? Please annotate the sheet with any changes.
- Ben: I’ll need a short SOW with fixed pilot cap. Ben — can you share a simple contract version we can send to procurement@peregrinepay.com?
- Alicia / Mike: if procurement wants a fixed not-to-exceed, we can convert the pilot into a capped engagement with milestone-based payments. Let me know preference.

I’ve attached an updated TCO workbook (same filename) with the sensitivity table filled and a one-page pilot SOW that includes the $20k capped option.

Available slots for the technical deep-dive next week (PST): Mon 4/23 10:00–11:00, Tue 4/24 14:00–15:00. Marissa, pick the slot that works and I’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks all — short and pragmatic path to a pilot.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: peregrine_tco_sheet.xlsx (updated with sensitivity table), pilot-sow-draft.pdf (includes 8-week capped option)
